trello.name: Venue contract execution
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Deadline: end of next week. Get the convention center contract (main hall plus two breakout rooms, $18,000, catering separate) through legal review and signed by end of next week. Confirm in writing that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms, not main-hall only.

trello.name: Speaker lineup finalization
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Deadline: lineup locked within two weeks. Send final follow-ups to the two maybe speakers with a decision deadline of Friday; use the backup list of five names to fill any slots that fall through, including the third slot if needed. Lock the full lineup of nine speakers within two weeks so the agenda can be printed.

trello.name: Keynote abstract acquisition
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Deadline: this week. Chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract this week; it is required for the website and the printed program.

trello.name: Email campaign creation and execution
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Deadline: draft all three waves this month; first wave goes out the day the agenda is live. Draft three email campaign waves this month: (1) agenda announcement when Bo locks the lineup, (2) early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change, (3) final-week push. The first wave must go out the day the agenda is live.

trello.name: Speaker pages on website
trello.desc: Owners: Bo (handoff) and Diego (landing page update). Deadline: same day the lineup locks. Once the lineup locks, Bo hands speaker bios and headshots to Diego the same day; Diego updates the speaker pages on the landing page before wave one of the email campaign goes out.

trello.name: Swag design approval and order placement
trello.desc: Owners: Camille (approval) and Diego (order). Deadline: Camille reviews proofs today; Diego places the order this week once approved. Camille reviews and approves the swag design proofs in the shared drive today; once approved, Diego places the order this week for 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, and 1,000 stickers (~$9,200 including rush buffer). Lead time is approximately six weeks, so this is time-critical.
